name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying engineering at the University of Belgrade, a chance encounter with a local rally team ignited a passion that soon eclipsed his academic pursuits. He started volunteering, quickly proving his aptitude for logistics and organization. His meticulous nature and ability to remain calm under pressure saw him rise through the ranks, eventually leading to a position with Ipiranga Racing.

As a logistics coordinator, Nikola prides himself on anticipating potential problems and proactively addressing them. He believes that successful logistics are invisible – when everything runs smoothly, it's a testament to his team's hard work and preparation. He is driven by a desire for perfection, always seeking ways to improve efficiency and streamline processes, ensuring the team is always one step ahead.

What sets Nikola apart is his calm demeanor amidst the chaos of a race weekend. He is a master of de-escalation, able to mediate disputes and find solutions under immense pressure. His dedication extends beyond the track; he is known for his commitment to mentoring junior team members, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Nikola is of medium height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously noting down every detail.
Has a peculiar fondness for strong Serbian coffee, brewing a fresh pot every morning.
Insists on double-checking all manifests and shipping documents, even when others have already verified them.
